$description: Candy, Keyling's default theme: dark navy with a color per app. Design Tokens Format (DTCG): colors are sRGB hex.

accent.$description: Focus and headers without an app color

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on accent, good, bad and warn

on-app.$description: Text and icons on app colors

bluetooth-connected.$description: Bluetooth symbol while a phone is connected

app.$description: Colors for apps, screens and other items that need telling apart; each project decides which item takes which

pill.$description: Status pills on the home screen (profile, Bluetooth and USB)

badge.$description: Fully round: site badges on security key prompts

tile-radius-ratio.$description: App tiles' corner radius as a share of the tile's size

site.$description: Site names on security key prompts: monospaced, every look-alike character distinct (OFL-1.1)
